description: Dertien vaste opdrachten (klein tot complex) op het scoreboard-sjabloon. Een run slaagt als Studio de wijziging na de controle (flutter analyze + rooktest) bewaart én alle controles hieronder kloppen. Controles zijn bewust eenvoudig (aanwezigheid van kenmerken, plus een echte test bij de bug); ze meten of het model de taak heeft uitgevoerd, niet of de oplossing mooi is.

tasks.prompt: Change the title in the top bar of the scoreboard screen to 'Game Night'.
Make the player name in the player card bold.
Change the tooltip of the reset button to 'Start over'.
Add a small button to each player card that sets only that player's score back to zero.
Show the total of all scores under the title on the scoreboard screen.
Add a second screen called Settings with a switch labelled 'Sound effects', reachable from an icon button in the top bar of the scoreboard screen.

Add a game history: a Game model (name, date, scores per player), a controller that keeps finished games in memory, a 'Finish game' button on the scoreboard that saves the current scores as a game and resets the scores, and a History screen that lists the games, reachable from the top bar.
Rename the score of a player to 'points' everywhere in the app (model, controller and screens), and keep the app working.
Bug: when I press the minus button on a player card, the score goes up instead of down. Please fix it.
Add a dark mode switch: keep the choice in a Riverpod provider, apply it through themeMode in the app, and put the toggle in the top bar of the scoreboard screen.

Add a tournament mode: the players are paired in rounds (everyone plays everyone once), a screen shows the matches of the current round, and after a score is entered for every match the standings (wins and points) update. Put the pairing and standings logic in plain Dart code and cover it with unit tests.

Make the scores survive an app restart: store the players and their scores on the device with the shared_preferences package, load them when the app starts, and cover the saving and loading logic with a unit test.
Sometimes the reset button does not reset everything: one of the players keeps their score. Find out why and fix it.
